quotes.text: A storage Calendar can still receive a read after `profile-change-teardown`. Reading `params` on a finalized SQLite statement can assert or crash. Guard the statement's state before parameter access; a stream may swallow only the known shutdown error, not arbitrary failures. The regression test deliberately avoids first use before teardown.
